question.problem: Change the order of integration in the double integral ${\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{1}^{2-{y}^{2}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y.$
question.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14154008/assets/48a1ef0d61b8b81e2fa0649b95a329099d48a802a5339d730f2da9cf8b59f547.png)

The diagram above shows the region of integration. It is a type II region, and its type II representation is

$$
D=\{(x,y)\,:\,0\le y\le 1,\,1\le x\le 2-{y}^{2}\}.
$$

Notice that the top boundary of the region, written in the form $x=x(y),$ is

$$
x=2-{y}^{2}\,⟹\,y=\sqrt{2-x},
$$

and the bottom boundary of the region is

$$
y=0.
$$

To change the order of integration, we write $D$ as a type I region. The type I representation of the region is

$$
D=\{(x,y)\,:\,1\le x\le 2,\,0\le y\le \sqrt{2-x}\},
$$

as shown in the diagram below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14154008/assets/22d41ecc443e1520035f52fefe524d88062432ab1643aa19b2e0b76185b191a0.png)

Therefore, swapping the order of integration, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{1}^{2-{y}^{2}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{2-x}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x.\end{aligned}
$$
